title: Gene Expression and Regulation
objectives: Outline the steps from gene to functional protein
Compare prokaryotic and eukaryotic gene regulation
Explain how mutations affect expression patterns

expression_steps.title: Transcription & Translation
expression_steps.content:
1. Transcription Initiation: RNA polymerase binds promoter (TATA box)
  2. Elongation: 5'→3' RNA synthesis (antisense strand template)
  3. Translation: Ribosome reads mRNA codons (AUG start)

regulation_mechanisms.title: Expression Control
regulation_mechanisms.content:
Prokaryotic (Operons)
• Lac operon: Lactose-inducible
• Trp operon: Tryptophan-repressible
Eukaryotic
• Enhancers/silencers
• Histone modifications (acetylation ↑ transcription)
• miRNA post-transcriptional regulation

clinical_correlation.title: Expression Disorders
clinical_correlation.content:
β-Thalassemia

Mechanism: Mutated β-globin promoters/enhancers

Result: Imbalanced α/β globin chains

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Why can identical twins have different gene expression?

Epigenetic differences (DNA methylation, histone modifications) accumulate due to environmental exposures and stochastic events.
